caption:
Rented, borrowed, or owned.

Every lead you generate ends up in one of three places. Only one of them still reaches customers when Instagram changes its algorithm or you turn off the ad.

Rented: ad platforms and search rank. Pay to reach it, pay again next month.
Borrowed: followers and review sites. You built the audience. The platform owns the access.
Owned: a phone number or email inside a CRM you control. Export it, keep it, message it for free.

This week: pull your last 90 days of leads. Mark each one rented, borrowed, or owned. Count what's actually yours.

Watch your database work like a real asset. 14 days free.
